blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.
blocks.zh: 许多密钥值(KV)缓存被压缩后,人们才知道要问它们什么:一个缓存用于检索的文档,一个跨请求共享的快速前缀,一个长对话的内存. 流行的方法通过排练来评分KV条目:模型重读上下文并保留它所处理的条目,假设缓存排练其上下文越彻底,就越能记住. 我们显示,在预算紧张的情况下,这种假设是消极的:排练一切,什么都不记得。 在3%的保存比率下,整个上下文的重读保留了 RAULLR的96.5分中的31.5分,在Long Bench的自然文本任务上,它低于完全没有排练的方法. 原因是缓存会保留它所排练的内容:重读会将预算分散到整个上下文中,因此答案自己的条目仅能以几率生存. 和考试前的学生一样,缓存通过测试本身而不是通过重读来记忆更多. 接下来是两项原则:排练将要阅读的内容,排练的尽量多. 我们以Attic-KV(Attic for short)的形式将他们作为即兴表演,这是一次免费的排练,在排练中,模型用引用上下文的回答对自己进行测试,同时用内容适应的量来锁定符号。 只更改排练 提升三个主机 得分有三种不同方式: 仅阁楼是我们在 RULAR 和 Long Bench 的自然文字任务上测试的所有8个场合中最好的无训练方法,并插入基于梯度的 KVgrad 和经过训练的 ReturnKV+, 它将它们提升至17.1和28.1分. 它的优势随着预算的收缩而增长,在3%的保有率下,在完全重读后达到41.9分,压缩速度比整个上下文的重读快.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
When Watson learns that Sherlock Holmes does not know that the Earth travels round the Sun, Holmes explains that a man’s brain is like a little empty attic ( Doyle, 1887 ) .
A fool stocks it with every sort of lumber he comes across, until the knowledge that might be useful is crowded out; a skilful workman takes in nothing but the tools that may help him in his work, and of those he keeps a large assortment.
For, as Holmes warns, “it is a mistake to think that that little room has elastic walls.”
A compressed key–value (KV) cache is such an attic: it holds a small, fixed fraction of a context’s keys and values, and what it holds decides which questions the model can still answer.
blocks.zh:
当华生得知夏洛克·福尔摩斯并不知道地球环绕太阳行走时,福尔摩斯解释说一个人的大脑就像一个小空的阁楼(多尔,1887年).
一个傻瓜用他遇到的各种木材来储存它,直到可能有用的知识被挤出;一个熟练的工人只接受可能有助于他工作的工具,以及他所保存的大量种类的工具。
因为,正如福尔摩斯所警告的那样,“认为这个小房间有弹性墙壁是错误的。 “
一个被压缩的密钥-值(KV)缓存就是这样一个阁楼:它持有一个上下文的密钥和值的一小部分固定的分数,它持有什么来决定模型还能回答哪些问题.

blocks.en:
Many KV caches are filled before the questions are known.
Retrieval-augmented and search systems precompute the caches of documents and reuse them across requests ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) ; serving systems share the cache of a long prompt prefix across users; assistants keep the cache of a long conversation for turns that have not happened yet.
Each such cache is compressed once and then serves many queries that are unknown when it is compressed ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Laguna et al., 2026 ) .
Compression must therefore be query-agnostic and one-shot , and because memory grows with the number of caches, it pays off only when it is extreme: a 5% keep ratio fits 20 times as many caches in the same memory, a 30% ratio only about 3 times (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh:
许多 KV 缓存在问题已知之前被填入.
检索和搜索系统预先计算出文件的缓存并跨请求重复使用(Gim等,2024;Jin等,2024;Lu等,2024;Yao等,2025;服务系统在用户之间共享一个很长的快速前缀的缓存;助理保留一个长对话的缓存以进行尚未发生的转会.
每个这样的缓存一次被压缩,然后服务于许多在压缩时未知的查询(沈等,2026;拉古纳等,2026.).
因此压缩必须是查询不可知和一发相,由于内存会随着缓存数量的增长而增长,它只有在极端时才会得到回报:5%的保存比例符合同一内存中缓存数量的20倍,30%的比例只有大约3倍(第2节).

blocks.en:
The prevailing paradigm for this setting is rehearsal scoring , introduced by KVzip ( Kim et al., 2025 ) .
Before any question arrives, the model rehearses the context, rereading it while attending to the cache; each KV entry is scored by the attention it receives, and the top-scoring entries are kept.
Its successors refine the scorer (KVzip+ and KVzap ( Jégou and Jeblick, 2026 ) , Fast KVzip ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , EchoPress ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , KVgrad ( Kwak et al., 2026 ) ) or what a retained subset can express (RestoreKV ( Baek et al., 2026 ) ), yet all of them rehearse the same target: the entire context.
KVzip argues explicitly for full-context rehearsal ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and the whole line shares its default assumption: the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the more faithfully it preserves it.
KV 2 ( Wesch et al., 2026 ) rehearses only a fixed fraction of the context, its anchor tokens; but like every rehearsal before it, what it rehearses is a copy of the context.
blocks.zh:
KVzip(Kim等人, 2025年)介绍了排练评分,
在任何问题到来之前,模型会排练上下文,在处理缓存时会重新读取;每个KV条目都会被它得到的注意所打分,并保留得分最高的条目.
其接班人完善了计分器(KVzip+和KVzap(Jégou和Jeblick,2026年)),快克Vzip (Kim等,2026年), Echo. Press (Lin等, 2026). KVGrad. (克瓦克等, 2026))或保留子集可以表达什么(RestoreKV (Baek等, 2026)),然而他们都排练了同一个目标:整个上下文.
KVzip明确提出要进行全文排练(Kim等,2025年),整行都赞同其默认假设:越是完全的缓存排练其上下文,就越忠实地保留了它.
车牌 2 (Wesch等,2026年)只排练了上下文的一分一分,即其主播标志;但和之前的每次排练一样,它排练的是上下文的复制品.

blocks.en:
We show that this assumption fails exactly where compression matters: rehearse everything, remember nothing .
On RULER-4K ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-8B scores 96.5 without compression, but full-context rehearsal (KVzip+) at a 3% keep ratio keeps only 31.5; on the natural-text tasks of LongBench it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all (28.6 vs. up to 36.5). Where does the budget go? For each question, we measure how much of its answer’s KV survives compression: at a 5% keep ratio, full-context rehearsal keeps 5.7–7.1% of it on seven of eight needle tasks, no more than of any other token (Figure 2 ). The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses (Section 3 ): rehearsed positions cover about 5% of the context yet draw a fifth to a third of the retained budget, and when the model rehearses only a list of facts, its score on each task tracks the coverage of that list. Capacity is not the bottleneck: a 5% cache scored by rehearsing the answer loses almost nothing (93.5 vs. 94.7 uncompressed). A full-context rehearsal spends the budget on fluent prose that no query reads and crowds out the few facts that every query reads, and the tighter the budget, the harder the crowding.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,这种假设在压缩重要之处是失败的:排练一切,什么都不记得。
在RULAR-4K(Hsieh等,2024年)上,Quen3-8B在不压缩的情况下得分96.5分,但满文排练(KVzip+)以3%的保持比例只保留了31.5分;在Long Bench的自然文本任务上,它低于完全没有排练的方法(28.6分对36.5分). 预算到哪里去? 对于每个问题,我们衡量其KV在压缩中存活了多少:在5%的保持比例下,满文排练在8个针头任务中的7个任务上保留了5.7–7.1 % , 不超过其他任何符号(图2)。 原因是缓存会保留它排练的内容(第3节):排练的姿势覆盖了大约5%的上下文,却画出所保留预算的五分之一至三分之一,当模型排练了仅一个事实清单时,其在每个任务上的分数跟踪该清单的覆盖范围. 能力不是瓶颈:通过排练答案得分的5%的缓存几乎一无所获(93.5对94.7不压缩). 满文排练将预算花在流利的口语上,即没有查询读取并挤出每个查询读取的少数事实,预算越收紧,拥挤越多.

blocks.en:
The failure has a familiar shape.
A student preparing for an exam can reread the chapter, reread only what they highlighted, or test themselves on it.
A large review of study techniques rates the first two of low utility and the third of high utility ( Dunlosky et al., 2013 ) : practice that produces answers beats seeing the material again ( Roediger and Karpicke, 2006 ) .
Existing rehearsals are the first two strategies: full-context rehearsal rereads the whole context, and KV 2 rereads its highlights.
Neither rehearses what a reader will read out of the context, and a compressed cache, like a student, remembers what it practises.
What counts as practice is specific: rehearsing a question without its answer keeps a cache that scores 47.0, against 93.5 when the answer is rehearsed with it, because attention lands on the answer only while the answer is produced (Section 4.1 ). Query-agnostic compression is thus first a question of how a cache should study: on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K, replacing the KVzip+ scorer with KVgrad’s gradient attribution adds 13.4 points at a 5% keep ratio and 22.0 at 3%, while replacing its rehearsal with ours adds 23.5 and 41.9.
blocks.zh:
失败的形状很熟悉.
准备考试的学生可以重读章节,只重读他们强调的内容,或者在其中测试自己.
对学习技术的大规模审查对前两个低功用和第三个高功用进行了评分(Dunlosky等,2013年):产生答案的做法比再次看到材料(Roediger和Karpicke,2006年)。
已存在的排练是前两种策略:全文排练重读整个上下文,而KV 2则重读其亮点.
既不排练读者会从上下文中读出的内容,压缩的缓存,像学生一样,会记住它的做法.
实际做法是具体的:在没有答案的情况下重唱一个问题,保留了47.0分的缓存,而93.5分则用它排出答案,因为注意力只落在答案上,而答案才产生(第4.1节)。 因此,查询-不可知压缩首先是一个缓存应如何研究的问题:在Qwen3-8B RULR-4K上,用KVgrad的梯度归属取代了KVzip+分数,增加了13.4分,保持比为5%;22.0分为3%;而用我们的排练替换排练则增加了23.5分和41.9分.

blocks.en: Two principles follow. Rehearse what will be read : a cache should rehearse what future queries will read out, not the whole context; rehearsing only the facts that can be asked already solves the fact-sparse tasks that full-context rehearsal fails (Section 4.1 ). Rehearse as much as there is : the amount of rehearsal should follow how much readable content a context holds, not a fraction fixed in advance; at an equal average amount, a content-adaptive amount beats a fixed fraction (78.0 vs. 74.6; Section 4.2 ). Under these principles, prior methods become special cases rather than rivals: both fix the amount before reading the context, KVzip at the whole of it and KV 2 at a fraction ρ \rho , and a content-adaptive rehearsal approaches KVzip as the budget loosens.
blocks.zh: 以下两项原则。 重排将要读到的内容 : 缓存应该重排未来的询问会读出的内容, 而不是整个上下文 ; 重排仅重排可以询问的事实就解决了完整文本排练失败的事实分割任务( 第4.1节) 。 排练次数应该跟随一个上下文有多少可读内容,而不是预先固定的分数;在相等的平均分数中,一个内容适应量比一个固定分数(78.0对74.6;第4.2节.). 在这些原则下,前置方法成为特例而不是对等方法:既在读取上下文前将金额固定,KVzip在整体上和KV 2在分数 $\rho 上,随着预算的放松,内容适应性排练接近KVzip.

blocks.en:
Guided by these principles, we propose Attic-KV ( Attic for short), named after Holmes’s brain-attic. Attic builds the rehearsal from three parts: self-generated QA rehearsal , in which the model writes the questions it expects to be asked and answers them by quoting the context; anchors ( Park et al., 2025 ) , which decide what else to rehearse; and the length of the sentences that contain them, which decides how much ( content-adaptive amount ). Attic is training-free and changes only the rehearsal, so it plugs into any rehearsal-scoring host method without altering its scoring (“+ Attic ”), and it accepts the released restore tokens of RestoreKV without retraining.
Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: by attention, by gradient attribution, and with trained restore tokens.
Alone, Attic is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test (RULER, and the 14 natural-text tasks of LongBench), and at a 3% keep ratio on RULER-4K it scores 73.4, 6.4 points above KV 2 and 41.9 above KVzip+, a lead that grows as the budget shrinks (Figure 1 , right). Plugged into KVgrad, it raises the host by up to 17.1 points, and KVgrad + Attic beats every existing training-free method in all eight settings; plugged into RestoreKV+, it raises the host by up to 28.1 points and beats every existing method in all six settings where restore tokens exist (Table 1 ). It is also cheaper: because it rehearses a fraction of each context rather than all of it, compressing a LooGLE document and answering all of its questions takes 126.0 s against 154.8 s for KVzip+. We make three contributions: • Paradigm Reformulation : We identify full-context rehearsal, the shared default of rehearsal scoring, as the cause of its failure under tight budgets; we show that a cache keeps what it rehearses , so that what a cache remembers depends more on what it rehearses than on how it scores the rehearsal; we observe that every existing rehearsal, the whole context or its anchors, rereads the context instead of practising what will be read out of it; and we recast query-agnostic compression as deciding what and how much to rehearse under two principles, rehearse what will be read and rehearse as much as there is , with KVzip and KV 2 as fixed-amount special cases. • Practical Solution : We propose Attic , a training-free rehearsal built from self-generated QA, anchors and a content-adaptive amount, which serves alone or as a plug-in to existing hosts and composes with released restore tokens. • Experimental Evaluation : On RULER with four LLMs and the natural-text tasks of LongBench with two, Attic is the best training-free method, every host it enters beats every existing method that trains as little as it does, and the margin widens as the budget tightens; on LooGLE, where each document is compressed once and answers all of its questions, Attic with restore tokens leads on both short- and long-dependency questions (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
在这些原则的指导下,我们提出Attic-KV(简称Attic),以福尔摩斯的"脑"来命名. 阁楼从三部分构建了排练:自我生成的QA排练,模型在排练中写出它预期要问的问题并用上下文来解答;主播(Park等,2025年),主播决定了排练的其他内容;以及包含这些内容的句子的长度,由它决定了多少(内容适应量. 阁楼是免受训练的,只改变排练,所以它插入任何排练得分的主机方法而不会改变它的分数 ("+阁楼"),它接受释放的不再培训的还原克瓦克(ReturnKV)符号.
只更改排练可以举起以三种不同方式评分的三个主机:通过注意力,梯度归属,以及训练有素的还原符.
单独来说,阁楼是我们测试的所有8个环境(RULER,以及Long Bench的14个自然文本任务)中最好的无培训方法,在RULR-4K上保持3%的比例,它得分73.4分,KV 2和KVzip+上41.9分,这一领先值随着预算收缩而增长(图1,右)。 被插入了KVgrad,将主机提升了最多17.1分,而KVgrad + Attic在所有8个设置中都击败了所有现有的无训练方法;被插入了还原KV+,将主机提升了最多28.1分并击败了所有存在还原令牌的6个设置中现有的每个方法(表1). 这也比较便宜:因为它排练了每个上下文的一小部分而不是全部上下文,压缩一个 LooGLE 文件并回答其所有问题需要126.0 s,而KVzip+需要154.8 s. 我们作出三项贡献: 我们确定完整文本排练、共享预设排练积分,是预算紧张导致排练失败的原因;我们显示缓存保留它排练的内容,这样缓存记忆更多取决于它排练的内容,而不是它如何评分排练;我们观察到,每个现有的排练、整个上下文或主播,都重读上下文,而不是练习将读出的内容;我们改写了查询-不可知压缩,以决定在两个原则下排练的内容和内容,排练将阅读和排练多少,只要有,KVzip和KV 2是固定-amount特例。 • 实际解决办法:我们提议用自制的QA、主播和内容适应量建造的免费训练排练阁楼,单独或作为现有主机的插头,并配有释放的还原物。 • 实验评价:在有四个LLM和有两个Long Bench的自然文本任务的情况下,Attic是最佳的无培训方法,它进入的每个主机都比它少得多地训练,比值随着预算收紧而扩大;在LooGLE,每个文件一次压缩一次并回答所有问题,Attic在短和长期依赖性问题上都有恢复信号线索(第5节)。

blocks.en: Paradigm Reformulation : We identify full-context rehearsal, the shared default of rehearsal scoring, as the cause of its failure under tight budgets; we show that a cache keeps what it rehearses , so that what a cache remembers depends more on what it rehearses than on how it scores the rehearsal; we observe that every existing rehearsal, the whole context or its anchors, rereads the context instead of practising what will be read out of it; and we recast query-agnostic compression as deciding what and how much to rehearse under two principles, rehearse what will be read and rehearse as much as there is , with KVzip and KV 2 as fixed-amount special cases.
blocks.zh: 范式改编: 我们确定完整文本排练、共享预设排练积分,是预算紧张导致排练失败的原因;我们显示缓存保留它排练的内容,这样缓存记忆更多取决于它排练的内容,而不是它如何评分排练;我们观察到,每个现有的排练、整个上下文或主播,都重读上下文,而不是练习将读出的内容;我们改写了查询-不可知压缩,以决定在两个原则下排练的内容和内容,排练将阅读和排练多少,只要有,KVzip和KV 2是固定-amount特例。

blocks.en: Practical Solution : We propose Attic , a training-free rehearsal built from self-generated QA, anchors and a content-adaptive amount, which serves alone or as a plug-in to existing hosts and composes with released restore tokens.
blocks.zh: 实用解决方案:我们提议阁楼,一个免费的排练,由自创的QA,主播和内容适应量组成,单独或作为现有主机的插件,并配有已发行的还原符.

blocks.en: Experimental Evaluation : On RULER with four LLMs and the natural-text tasks of LongBench with two, Attic is the best training-free method, every host it enters beats every existing method that trains as little as it does, and the margin widens as the budget tightens; on LooGLE, where each document is compressed once and answers all of its questions, Attic with restore tokens leads on both short- and long-dependency questions (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 实验评价: 在有4个LLM和有2个Long Bench的自然文字任务上的RULR上,Attic是最佳的无训练方法,它进入的每个主机都比它少得多地打败每一个现有的训练方法,比值随着预算的收紧而扩大;在LooGLE上,每个文件都压缩一次并回答所有问题,Attic在短和长期依赖性问题上都恢复了指示符号线索(第5节)。

blocks.en: Many KV caches are built before anyone knows what will be asked of them. A retrieval-augmented or search system prefills each document of its corpus once and stores the cache for every later request that retrieves it ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) ; a serving system shares the cache of a long system prompt or few-shot prefix across users; an assistant keeps the cache of a long conversation or a tool output for turns that have not happened yet. Two properties are common to all of them. (I) One compression, many unknown queries. A cache is compressed once and then serves every future query on its context, none of which is known when the cache is compressed. (II) Memory grows with the number of caches. At keep ratio r r , a fixed memory holds 1 / r 1/r times as many caches as it holds full ones: 20 times at r = 5 % r=5\% , but only about 3 times at r = 30 % r=30\% . Compression pays off at a few percent, and 3–5% is the regime we target.

Is the loss then a matter of capacity, a 5% subset too small to hold what a question needs?
An answer-aware oracle settles this.
When the rehearsal is the question followed by its gold answer, attention scoring keeps a 5% subset that scores 93.5, against 94.7 without compression. The subset has room.
Rehearsing the whole document instead, with the same scorer and budget, scores 37.8, and 58.9 even with the KVzip+ normalization of Eq. ( 2 ): the loss comes from what is rehearsed, not from how much is kept.

blocks.en:
If the budget follows the rehearsal, it should reach the answer itself only when the rehearsal leads it there.
For each of the 425 questions on the eight needle tasks (Figure 2 ), we measure the share of the answer’s KV entries, over all layers and heads, that the cache keeps; at r = 5 % r=5\% , a cache that singles nothing out keeps about 5%. Whole-document rehearsal keeps 5.7–7.1% on seven of the eight tasks: the budget lands on the answer no more often than on any other token. The exception, S1, hides its needle in one sentence repeated over and over; a rereading model predicts the haystack and needs to read back only the needle, which keeps 50.1%. In a natural-text haystack nearly every token is unpredictable, so a full reread reads them all back and spreads the budget evenly. The answer-aware oracle keeps 48.4% on average. Attic , the rehearsal we build in Section 4 , keeps 15.0–17.0% on the five tasks that it lifts to 94–100 points, and stays at the 5% share on MK2 and MK3, the two tasks it leaves unsolved. Attic solves the tasks where it draws the budget to the answer, and only those.
At a 3% keep ratio, whole-document rehearsal stays near chance (3.5–5.0%), while Attic still keeps 13.2–14.7% of the answer on the same five tasks, now 4.5 times chance: a targeted rehearsal protects the answer as the budget shrinks, so the gap widens (Sec. 5.3 ).

blocks.en:
The three pieces of evidence identify the cause behind our headline: a cache keeps what it rehearses .
A full-document rehearsal singles out nothing, so it spreads the budget over the whole document, and most of a document is fluent prose.
Under a tight budget, that prose crowds out the few facts that will be asked.
The crowding sharpens as the budget shrinks, so the gap between full and targeted rehearsal must widen as r r falls; Section 5.3 confirms this prediction.
blocks.zh:
这三件证据 找出我们头条背后的原因: 一个缓存 保留它排练的东西。
完整的文件排练只字不提,因此将预算分散在整个文件上,文件大多流利地传出.
在预算紧张的情况下, 传言挤出 少数事实将问。
随着预算的收缩,拥挤加剧,因此,全面排练和有针对性的排练之间的差距必须随着r r 下降而扩大;第5.3节证实了这一预测。

blocks.en: 4. Two Principles and Attic
blocks.zh: 4. 两项原则和阁楼

blocks.en:
Section 3 reduces query-agnostic compression to the design of the rehearsal R R , which has two degrees of freedom: what it contains, and how much of it there is.
We state one principle for each, ground each in controlled experiments, and build Attic from the two.
blocks.zh:
第3节将查询-不可知压缩简化为预演R R的设计,预演有两种自由度:包含什么,以及有多少.
我们为每一个都规定一个原则, 在受控制的实验中每个地面, 并且从两个建筑阁楼。

blocks.en: 4.1. Principle 1: Rehearse What Will Be Read
blocks.zh: 4.1. 原则1:重审将要读取的内容

blocks.en:
A future query reads out a few spans of a document: the value bound to a key, the date of an event, the name in a claim.
The rehearsal should reproduce these spans as they would be read out, not the document.
Three experiments support this principle.
blocks.zh:
未来的查询会读出文件的几个跨度:与密钥绑定的值,事件的日期,索赔中的名称.
排练应复制这些跨度,因为将宣读这些跨度,而不是文件。
三个实验都支持这一原则.

blocks.en: (I) Rehearsing only what is read is nearly lossless. On the needle tasks of RULER-4K, rehearsing only the needle sentences, i.e., every fact that can be asked, under the same budget as KVzip+ scores 98.5–100 on every fact-sparse task at both r = 5 % r=5\% and r = 3.125 % r=3.125\% ; its lead over KVzip+ grows from 24–58 to 74–83 points(on MK1, KVzip+ falls from 44.4 to 18.5).
blocks.zh: (一)只排练所读的几乎无所失. 在RULAR-4K的针头任务上,只排练出针头句,即每个可以询问的事实,在与KVzip+相同的预算下,在每次事实平分任务上,在r = 5% r = 5\%和r = 3.125 r = 3.125\%;在KVzip+上的领先点从24-58分增长到74-83分(在MK1上,KVzip+从44.4分下降到18.5).

blocks.en:
(II) Reading the question is not reading the answer. Rehearsing the question alone, without its answer, scores 47.0, against 93.5 with the answer under the same scorer. While reading a question, attention lands on the key it names; only while producing the answer does it land on the value.
A rehearsal must therefore reproduce the read-out, not the request.
blocks.zh:
(二)读出问题不是读出答案. 单凭问题排练,没有答案,得分47.0分,对93.5分,答案在同一分数下. 在读出一个问题的同时,注意力落在它命名的钥匙上;只有在生成答案时,注意力才会落在价值上.
因此,排练必须复制宣读,而不是请求。

blocks.en:
(III) Self-generated read-outs carry over to natural text. On LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , an answer-aware rehearsal keeps a 5% subset that matches the uncompressed model (44.9 vs. 44.4), so on natural text, too, the loss lies in what is rehearsed. A deployable rehearsal cannot see the questions, but the model can anticipate them: asked to write the questions a reader is likely to ask and to answer each by quoting the document, it produces read-outs of the spans it expects to be asked.
Adding this self-generated QA rehearsal to an anchor rehearsal raises the LongBench development average from 38.2 to 39.6; Section 5.6 shows the same gain on every RULER test setting.
blocks.zh:
(三)自发取出后转入自然文字. 在"Long Bench"(Bai等,2024年)上,一个有解答意识的排练保留了一个5%的子集,与未压缩模型(44.9 vs 44.4)相匹配,因此在自然文字上,损失也在于所排练的内容. 一次可部署的排练无法看到问题,但模型可以预见到问题:被要求写读者可能提出的问题,并且通过引用文件来回答每个问题,它会产生预期要问的跨度的读出.
将这种自发的QA排练加到主播排练中,将Long Bench的开发平均数从38.2提高到39.6;第5.6节显示,每个欧盟驻科法治团测试设置都有同样的收益。

blocks.en: 4.2. Principle 2: Rehearse As Much As There Is
blocks.zh: 4.2. 原则2:排练到现在为止

blocks.en:
Documents differ in how much of them can be asked.
A narrative may hide one fact in a page of prose, while a table or a list of records is facts from top to bottom.
The amount of rehearsal should follow this content instead of being fixed before the document is read.
blocks.zh:
文件可以问多少不同。
叙事可能将一个事实隐藏在一页的道词中,而表或记录列表则是从上到下的事实.
排练的数量应该遵循这个内容,而不是在读取文件之前固定。

blocks.en:
(I) A content-adaptive amount beats a fixed one at equal average. On the RULER-4K development split with Qwen3-8B, we compare two anchor rehearsals that rehearse about 35% of the context on average.
KV 2 with ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 rehearses 35% of every document and scores 74.6; the content-adaptive amount of Attic (Section 4.3 ) rehearses 11–100% per document, 34% on average, and scores 78.0. The gain comes where the content is dense: on MK2 and MK3, whose contexts are lists of key–value statements, the score rises from 27.0 to 54.0 and from 4.3 to 28.3. The amount tracks the content: over the needle-task contexts it correlates with the number of fact statements (Spearman correlation 0.59, n = 425 n=425 ), and contexts with ten or more facts are rehearsed in full (median 100%), while those with at most one are rehearsed at a median of 28%. On Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , it scores 76.1, against 73.9 for the best ρ \rho .

(III) KVzip and KV 2 are fixed-amount special cases. KVzip rehearses everything and KV 2 a fixed fraction, whatever the document holds; both fix the amount, and differ only in where.
In Attic , the number of anchors equals the keep ratio, so its rehearsal grows as the budget loosens and approaches the full document: KVzip is the loose-budget limit of Principle 2, not its opposite, and at loose budgets all methods meet (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: 5. Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate Attic through four research questions. RQ1 : Does Attic outperform existing query-agnostic methods, both on its own and when plugged into their host methods? RQ2 : How does its advantage change with the keep ratio? RQ3 : Does it carry over to compress-once, answer-many caching, where a document is compressed once and then answers all of its questions, and what does the compression cost? RQ4 : Can a fixed rehearsal ratio, however well tuned, catch up with Attic ?
We close with an ablation and a per-category view of LongBench.
blocks.zh:
我们通过四个研究问题来评价阁楼。 RQ1 : (韩语). 阁楼是否超越了现有的查询-不可知性方法,无论是单独还是插入主机方法时? RQ2 : (英语). 其优势如何随保持比例而变化? RQ3 : (中文(简体) ). 它是否延续到压缩-即时,答-多-缓冲,一个文件被压缩一次然后回答所有的问题,压缩的成本是什么? 问题4: 固定的排练比例,无论曲调如何,能否赶上阁楼?
我们以Long Bench的 淡出和每个类别的观点结束。

blocks.en: 5.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1. 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use four open LLMs from two families: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) .
We evaluate on three long-context benchmarks: (1) RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) at 4K and 16K context, whose 13 subtasks cover needle retrieval, multi-hop tracing, aggregation and question answering; (2) LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , whose English tasks include multi-hop QA over Wikipedia pages, QA over scientific papers, and summarization of news and reports; we report the average over its 14 natural-text tasks 1 1 1 We leave out LongBench’s Synthetic category, passage_count and passage_retrieval_en, which count or index paragraphs rather than ask about their content; 16-task results are in Appendix B . ; and (3) LooGLE ( Li et al., 2024b ) , long Wikipedia pages and arXiv papers, each paired with many questions, which we use for RQ3.
The main keep ratio is 5%; we add 3% on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K and sweep 3–30% in RQ2.
All choices are made on development splits of RULER and LongBench, and all reported numbers come from disjoint test splits (Appendix F ); LooGLE is used only for testing.

blocks.en: 5.2. Main Results (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 5.2. 主要成果(RQ1)

blocks.en: Table 1 covers seven model–benchmark pairs and a 3% budget.

blocks.en: Obs.❶ Rehearsing nothing and rehearsing everything both collapse at tight budgets; Attic is the best training-free method in all eight settings. Scoring without rehearsal fails first: the six heuristics score 3.4–50.8 on RULER. KeyDiff, whose score picks Attic ’s anchors, keeps 23.4 on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K; rehearsing those anchors instead of keeping them reaches 82.1. Rehearsing everything is no cure: KVzip+ keeps 58.6 of the 96.5 uncompressed score on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K and only 31.5 at 3%, and on Qwen3-8B LongBench four of the six heuristics, which rehearse nothing, score above it (31.6–36.5 vs. 28.6). Attic scores 82.1 and 73.4 in the two RULER settings, 5.3 and 6.4 points above the strongest training-free baseline, KV 2 with a dev-tuned ρ \rho , and on Qwen3-8B at 5% it also exceeds the trained RestoreKV+ (78.2). It leads every training-free baseline across context length, model size and natural text, by up to 6.6 points (87.6 vs. 81.0 on Qwen3-14B). Where a baseline comes close, it is a host that Attic improves: KVgrad is the nearest on RULER-16K, Qwen3-8B LongBench and Llama RULER-4K, and Attic plugged into it adds 5.9, 1.6 and 3.2 points there (Obs.❷). On Llama LongBench, KV 2 , the host of Attic itself, comes within 0.2 points, but only by switching to the ratio selected for LongBench (0.15 instead of RULER’s 0.5); Attic gets there, as everywhere, with one configuration that transfers unchanged across models, benchmarks and budgets.

KeyDiff的分数取自Attic的锚地,保持了23.4分的Qwen3-8B RULR-4K;再排练出这些锚地,而不是保持到82.1分. 重排一切是无法治愈的:KVzip+将96.5未压缩得分中的58.6分保留在了Qune3-8B RULAR-4K上,只有31.5分以3%的成绩,并保留了6个heuristics中的Qune3-8B Long Bench 4分,没有排练,得分高于它(31.6–36.5 vs 28.6). 阁楼在两个欧盟驻科法治团环境下得分为82.1分和73.4分,比最强的无训练基线高5.3分和6.4分,KV 2的成绩为dev-tuned $\rho;而Qune3-8B的成绩为5%,也超过了训练有素的ReptKV+(78.2). 它引导每个无训练基线跨越上下文长度,模型大小和自然文本,最多可达6.6分(Qune3-14B上87.6对81.0分). 当基线接近时,它就是Attic改进的宿主:KVgrad在 RuLIR-16K, Qune3-8B Long Bench和Llama RuLIR-4K上距离最近的宿主;而Attic插入它后会增加5.9分,1.6分和3.2分(Obs. 在Llama Long Bench上,KV 2,即阁楼本身的东道主,在0.2分以内,但只能通过切换为Long Bench选定的比例(0.15分而不是RULAR的0.5分);阁楼像到处一样到达那里,有一个配置在模型、基准和预算之间没有变化地转移。

blocks.en:
Obs.❷ Plugged into a host, Attic lifts it above every existing method that trains as little as it does. Plugged into KVgrad, the gradient-based host, Attic raises it by 11.7 points on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K, 17.1 at the 3% keep ratio, 3.2 on Llama, 9.3 on Qwen3-4B and 8.7 on Qwen3-14B; KVgrad + Attic beats every existing training-free method in all eight settings, and on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B (81.4 and 88.2) it is the best method overall. Plugged into RestoreKV+, the trained host, it raises it in every setting, from 0.8 points on Llama RULER-4K to 28.1 at the 3% keep ratio, and RestoreKV+ + Attic beats every existing method in all six settings where restore tokens exist, with an average rank of 1.00. The two hosts differ in how they score a rehearsal (attention vs. gradient attribution) and in whether anything is trained, yet both improve once they rehearse what will be read, as much as there is.
Full-context rehearsal fails by its target, not by its scorer or capacity.

Obs.X.X.插入一个主机,阁楼把它提升到 每一个现有的方法上, 火车像它一样少。 被插入了以梯度为主机的KVgrad,Attic将其在Qune3-8B RULR-4K上提升了11.7分,在3%的保持率上提升了17.1分,在Llama上提升了3.2分,在Qune3-4B上提升了9.3分,在Qune3-14B上提升了8.7分;KVgrad + Attic在所有8个场合下击败了所有现有的无训练方法,在Qune3-4B和Qune3-14B上提升了11.7分(81.4分和88.2分),这是总体最好的方法. 被插入了ReprestKV+,即训练有素的主机中,它在每个场合将其提升,从Llama RULAR-4K上0.8分提高到了3%的保持比上28.1分,在存在还原符的所有6个场合中ReprestKV++阁楼都击败了所有现有的方法,平均排名为1.00. 两位主持人在排练(注意与梯度归属)的得分和是否经过了训练方面,都有所不同,然而,一旦排练了将要阅读的内容,两者都会有所改进,只要有的话.
完全康特排练被其目标所失败,而不是被其计分员或能力所失败.

blocks.en: 5.3. Effect of the Budget (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 5.3. 预算的影响(RQ2)

blocks.en:
Our mechanism makes a quantitative prediction: if prose crowds facts out of a full-context rehearsal, the crowding, and with it our advantage, must grow as the budget shrinks and vanish once the budget holds everything rehearsed.
Figure 1 (right) sweeps the keep ratio on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K; Table 16 extends the sweep to 30%.
blocks.zh:
我们的机制做了一个量化的预测:如果散文者把事实挤出一个完整的内容排练,那么拥挤,并以此为优势,就必须随着预算收缩而增长,一旦预算保留了一切排练,就会消失.
图1 (右) 在 Qwen3-8B RULR-4K 上扫描了保存比率; 表16将扫描率扩展至30%.

blocks.en: Obs.❸ The advantage follows a dose–response curve: the tighter the budget, the wider the gap. The gap between Attic and KVzip+ is 1.1 points at a 10% keep ratio, 23.5 at 5% and 41.9 at 3%; with restore tokens, the gap to RestoreKV+ grows from 0.3 to 10.7 to 28.1 over the same ratios. At 10% both of our rows still lead their lines (94.1 vs. 93.0 for KVzip+ and 92.3 for KV 2 ; 95.2 vs. 94.9 for RestoreKV+). At 20% and 30%, every method lies within 0.7 points of the uncompressed 96.5, the loose-budget limit of Section 4.2 . The regime where compression matters most, 3–5%, is exactly where the gap is largest.

blocks.en: 5.4. Compress Once, Answer Many (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 5.4. 压缩一次,回答许多问题(RQ3)

blocks.en: LooGLE reproduces this setting directly: each long document is compressed once, before any question, and then answers all of its questions, 1951 over 105 documents in the short-dependency set and 459 over 60 in the long-dependency set.
blocks.zh: LooGLE直接复制了这个设置:每张长文件被压缩一次,在任何问题之前,然后回答它的所有问题,1951年在短依赖集中超过105个文件,在长依赖集中超过459个超过60个文件.

blocks.en: Obs.❹ Compressed once per page, RestoreKV+ + Attic serves all of the page’s questions best, and Attic ’s rehearsal costs less to build. RestoreKV+ + Attic is the best compressed method on both sets and both metrics (Table 2 ), above RestoreKV+ by 1.9 and 0.8 ROUGE-L and by 1.4 and 2.0 METEOR on the short- and long-dependency sets. On the short-dependency set, Attic alone leads all training-free methods, 1.9 ROUGE-L above KV 2 and 8.1 above KVzip+. Full-context rehearsal again loses most: KVzip+ keeps 28.1 of the uncompressed 65.7 ROUGE-L on short-dependency questions.
blocks.zh: Obs.Q.Q.每页压缩一次,RepresentKV+Attic最能解决所有页面的问题,Attic的排练费用更少。 ReprestKV++ Attic是两套和两套度量衡(表2)上的最佳压缩方法,上方的ReprestKV+以1.9和0.8 ROUGE-L并用1.4和2.0 METEOR在短和长依赖性集上. 在短的依赖性集上,阁楼独自领导所有无训练方法,1.9 ROUGE-L上方为KV 2和8.1上方为KVzip+. 全文排练再次输得最多:KVzip+保留了未压缩的65.7 ROUGE-L在短依赖性问题上的28.1.

blocks.en: Attic is cheaper to build than the full-rehearsal methods it replaces. Measured alone on one GPU over ten LooGLE documents (about 20 questions each), compressing a page and answering all of its questions takes 126.0 s with Attic against 154.8 s with KVzip+, and 142.5 s with RestoreKV+ + Attic against 154.6 s with RestoreKV+. Writing the 6 question–answer pairs takes about 11 s, less than rehearsing a fraction of the page saves, and all of it happens once per page, off the query path.
blocks.zh: 楼阁比它取代的全排练方法便宜. 仅用一个GPU的10个LooGLE文件(每个约20个问题)来衡量,压缩一页并回答其所有问题需要126.0 s与Attic对154.8 s与KVzip+,142.5 s与Attic对154.6 s与AtterKV+. 写出6个问答对需要约11 s,少于重排一分一页所保存的,并且全部发生在每页一次的查询路径外.

blocks.en: 5.5. Can a Tuned Ratio Catch Up? (RQ4)
blocks.zh: 5.5. 能否实现“补习率”? (RQ4)

blocks.en:
KV 2 rehearses a fixed fraction ρ \rho of each context; Attic lets the content decide.
If, as rehearse as much as there is states, the right amount depends on the content, the ratio KV 2 needs should move with it, and no single ρ \rho should match Attic everywhere.
blocks.zh:
KV 2 排练了每个上下文的固定分数 ^\rho; 阁楼让内容决定 。
如果,正如排练的状态一样,正确的金额取决于内容,那么KV 2需要的比例应该随它而移动,任何单一的\rho都不应该与任何地方的阁楼相匹配.

blocks.en:
Obs.❺ The ratio KV 2 needs is a property of the content; Attic reads it off the document. Selected on each development split, KV 2 ’s ratio for Llama is 0.5 on RULER-4K and 0.15 on LongBench (Qwen3-8B: 0.35 and 0.5). A query-agnostic cache that holds both kinds of documents would have to know in advance which kind each one is; the content-adaptive amount reads this off each document.
Figure 5 scans ρ \rho on the test splits, which gives KV 2 its best ratio in hindsight. On Llama, the best ratio for RULER-4K (0.5, 74.8) is the worst for LongBench (35.0), and no ratio comes within a point of Attic on both (77.2 and 39.3); on Qwen3-8B, the best ratios reach 76.8 and 39.1, against 82.1 and 40.6. The amount alone, without the QA rehearsal, already does what no ratio does: it beats every ρ \rho on RULER-4K (78.8 vs. at most 76.8 on Qwen3-8B, 75.6 vs. 74.8 on Llama; Table 15 ), and every ρ \rho that edges it on LongBench, by at most 0.8 points, falls 1.7–6.2 points behind it on RULER-4K.

blocks.en:
Obs.❻ The content-adaptive amount replaces a tuned ratio, and self-generated QA adds most where the budget is tightest. Table 3 builds Attic one step at a time from two baselines.
Replacing KV 2 ’s dev-tuned ratio with the content-adaptive amount gains up to 2.0 points and loses at most 1.5, with nothing tuned; replacing the full rehearsal of RestoreKV+ with it gains up to 23.0 points under the same restore tokens. Adding self-generated QA rehearsal raises every setting, by 1.6 to 5.6 points, with the largest gain at the 3% keep ratio. The QA gain survives on top of the restore tokens (1.1 to 5.1 points), which themselves add 2.3 to 9.2 to Attic : the two act on different sides of compression, what is selected and how much a selected subset can express.

blocks.en: 6. Related Work
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en: H2O ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) keeps heavy hitters of accumulated attention, StreamingLLM ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) keeps attention sinks and a recent window, SnapKV ( Li et al., 2024a ) and PyramidKV ( Cai et al., 2024 ) vote with an observation window at the end of the prompt, ChunkKV ( Liu et al., 2025b ) keeps semantic chunks rather than single tokens, Ada-KV ( Feng et al., 2025 ) adapts the budget across heads, and DapQ ( Tian et al., 2026 ) places pseudo queries at the positions of the first generated tokens. All were designed to read the question or the queries seen so far; run before it, as a compress-once cache must, they collapse (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: H2O(Zhang等,2023年)保留了积聚注意力的重击手,StreamingLLM(Xiao等,2024年)保留了注意力下沉和最近的窗口,SnapKV(Li等,2024年a)和PyramidKV(Cai等,2024年24年)使用观察窗口进行投票,ChunkKV(Liu等,2025年b)保留了语义块而不是单个符号,Ada-KV(Feng等,2025年)调整了预算,而DapQ(Tien等,2026年)则将伪质质询问放在了最早生成的符号的位置. 所有这些都是为了读取迄今为止所看到的问题或查询;在它之前运行,作为一次压缩的缓存,它们会崩溃(表1)。

blocks.en:
KVzip ( Kim et al., 2025 ) introduced scoring by rehearsal and argues explicitly that the whole context must be repeated. Its successors keep this target and improve the scorer or its cost: the KVzap paper ( Jégou and Jeblick, 2026 ) introduces KVzip+, which normalizes by the value contribution, and KVzap, Fast KVzip ( Kim et al., 2026 ) and EchoPress ( Lin et al., 2026 ) approximate the full-rehearsal score cheaply, and KVgrad ( Kwak et al., 2026 ) replaces attention with a gradient attribution. All are instances of the rehearse-everything default , and their scorers compose with our rehearsal. KV 2 ( Wesch et al., 2026 ) rehearses KeyDiff anchors ( Park et al., 2025 ) at a fixed ratio ρ \rho ; it is the fixed-ratio special case of rehearse as much as there is , and like full-context rehearsal it rehearses a copy of the context, and its own observation that the best ρ \rho drifts with the budget is what the principle predicts.
InfiniPot ( Kim et al., 2024 ) scores the cache with a short fixed “catalyst” prompt, and TaskPress ( Park and Hwang, 2026 ) replaces the rehearsal with a two-to-three-sentence task description written by an LLM; that the TaskPress probe already beats full-context rehearsal at 50–75% eviction is consistent with rehearse what will be read , though both probes are fixed in advance rather than drawn from the document.
blocks.zh:
KVzip(Kim等,2025年)通过排练引入了评分,并明确认为整个上下文必须重复. 其接班人保留了这个目标并改进了计分器或其成本:KVzap纸 (Jégou and Jeblick, 2026.)引入了KVzip+,通过价值贡献实现正常化,而KVzap,快克Vzip (Kim等, 2026.)和回声(EchoPress (Lin等, 2026.))则以梯度归属取代了注意力. 他们的计分员负责我们的排练 车牌 2 (Wesch等, 2026年)按固定比例排练了KeyDiff主播(Park等, 2025年;这是排练的固定比例特例, 和排练的一样多, 和满文排练一样,它排练了上下文的拷贝,
InfiniPot(Kim等, 2024年)用一个短的固定“催化器”快报对缓存进行评分,TaskPress(Park和Hwang, 2026年)用一个LLM所写的2至3个判决任务描述取代了排练;TaskPress探测器已经用50-75%的拆迁来完成完全的排练,这与排练将要阅读的内容是一致的,尽管这两个探测器都是事先固定的,而不是从文件中抽出.

blocks.en: RestoreKV ( Baek et al., 2026 ) enlarges what a kept subset can express with restore tokens trained on KVzip+ selections, rather than choosing the subset. Cartridges ( Eyuboglu et al., 2025 ) distill a document into a trained cache via self-study, Cartridges++ ( Laguna et al., 2026 ) guards it against off-context derailment, Attention Matching ( Zweiger et al., 2026 ) fits compact keys and values to reference queries, ARC-KV ( Shen et al., 2026 ) amortizes the anchor search of such compaction, and PatchKV ( Lee et al., 2026 ) compensates eviction in weight space. These methods share our compress-once, query-many setting; Attention Matching and ARC-KV draw most of their reference queries from a verbatim repeat of the context, another instance of the rehearse-everything default; Attention Matching adds a few self-study passes in which the model asks and answers its own questions, the closest relative of our question–answer rehearsal. Attic keeps native KV and trains nothing.
blocks.zh: ReprestKV(Baek等人,2026年)用KVzip+选择中训练的还原符来扩展所保存的子集能够表达的内容,而不是选择子集. Cartridges(Eyuboglu等,2025年)通过自学将一份文件分馏入训练有素的缓存,Cartridges++ (Laguna等,2026年)保护它防止脱轨出轨,"注意相配"(Zweiger等,2026年)符合紧凑的密钥和参考查询值,ARC-KV(Shen等,2026年)分期摊还了这种紧凑的锚地搜索,"PatchKV"(Lee等,2026年)补偿了重量空间内的驱逐. 这些方法共享我们的压缩- 即时, 查询- 众多的设置 ; 注意匹配和 ARC- KV 从上下文的逐字重复中抽取了大部分的参考查询, 这是排练- 一切默认的又一实例 ; 注意匹配增加了几个自学通行证, 模型在其中询问和回答自己的问题, 是我们问答排练中最接近的亲戚 。 阁楼保留着本地的KV,没有火车。

blocks.en: Retrieval practice, answering one’s own questions, is among the most effective ways for people to learn, and rereading among the least ( Roediger and Karpicke, 2006 ; Dunlosky et al., 2013 ) . Language models that must learn documents into their weights benefit from the same contrast: Cartridges ( Eyuboglu et al., 2025 ) find that training on the raw corpus memorizes the text but does not generalize, while self-study conversations do, and Active Reading ( Lin et al., 2025 ) lets the model generate its own study strategies, including active recall. Predicting the questions a document will be asked also has a precedent in retrieval, where doc2query ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ) expands documents with them. Attic brings the contrast to a setting where nothing is trained: the rehearsal selects which KV entries stay, and the model quizzes itself instead of rereading.
blocks.zh: 检索实践,回答自己的问题,是人们学习和重读的最有效方法之一(Roediger和Karpicke,2006年;Dunlosky等,2013年)。 必须将文件学习到其分量中的语言模型也得益于同样的对比: Cartridges(Eyuboglu等,2025年)发现生体训练能记住文字,但并不概括,而自学对话能实现,而Active Reading(Lin等,2025年)让模型产生自己的研究策略,包括活性回想. 预测要问的问题在检索方面也有先例,Doc2query(Nogueira等,2019年)将随文件扩充。 阁楼将对比带给一个没有被训练的设置:排练会选择KV条目所停留的,而模型会自己进行测试而不是再读.

blocks.en: Prompt Cache ( Gim et al., 2024 ) , CacheBlend ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , RAGCache ( Jin et al., 2024 ) and TurboRAG ( Lu et al., 2024 ) precompute document KV caches and reuse them across requests, LMCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) and Mooncake ( Qin et al., 2025 ) store them across GPU, CPU and disk tiers, solving fusion and latency for full-size caches whose storage grows with the corpus; SCBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) shows that compression conditioned on one request degrades when the same cache serves later ones, which is why such caches must be compressed query-agnostically; CacheGen ( Liu et al., 2024 ) encodes stored caches into compact bitstreams, and since encoding shrinks each kept entry and eviction how many are kept, the two multiply; Attic is the eviction that lets them scale to large corpora.
blocks.zh: 提示缓存 (Gim等,2024年),CacheBlend(Yao等,2025年),RAGCache(Jin等,2024年)和TurboRAG(Lu等,2024年)预先计算文件KV缓存并跨请求再使用,LMCache(Liu等,2025a年)和Mooncake(Qin等,2025年)将它们储存在GPU、CPU和磁盘分层之间,解决与该实体一起增长的全尺寸缓存的聚和缓存问题;SC Bench(Li等,2025年)显示,当同一缓存服务于后期时,一个请求的压缩条件会下降,这就是为何此类缓存必须压缩查询-不可知;CacheGen(Liu等,2024年)将缓存存储的缓存编码为紧凑的位流,而且由于编码缩小了每个存储的输入和驱逐数量,两个倍数。

blocks.en: Expected Attention ( Devoto et al., 2025 ) and CapKV ( Yang et al., 2026 ) model future queries statistically, as a Gaussian over hidden states or an information-capacity objective. Behavior-Preserving KV compression ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) also questions the reconstruction target of KVzip, replacing it with a next-token KL score at available query positions, LORE-KV ( Bilal et al., 2026 ) , Lookahead Q-Cache ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and SpecKV ( Galim et al., 2025 ) draft the response to a known request and score entries by the attention the draft pays them; that response-side queries beat prompt-side ones is the query-aware counterpart of rehearse what will be read . Judge Q ( Liu et al., 2026 ) trains soft query tokens whose attention imitates that of generated responses, and GVote ( Tang et al., 2025 ) samples synthetic queries from hidden-state statistics. Compactor ( Chari and Van Durme, 2025 ) scores entries without a rehearsal, by key leverage and non-causal attention, and calibrates the keep ratio to each context. Back from the Future ( Gould and van den Hengel, 2026 ) evicts entries that later tokens predict well, by a counter-causal pass over the cache. LLMLingua-2 ( Pan et al., 2024 ) compresses the text itself before prefill. Attic keeps rehearsal scoring and changes what, and how much, is rehearsed.
blocks.zh: 预期注意(Devoto等,2025年)和CapKV(Yang等,2026年)将未来的查询作为统计模型,作为高斯人超越隐藏状态或信息能力目标. 行为-保留KV压缩(Hwang等人,2026年)也质疑KVzip的重建目标,在已有的查询位置用下个KL分来取而代之,LORE-KV(Bilal等人,2026年),Lookahead Q-Cache(Wang等人,2025年)和SpecKV(Galim等人,2025年)起草对已知请求的答复并按草案所付的分数进行分数;响应-侧问讯比快-侧问讯是排练阅读内容的查询-意识对应. Q法官(Liu等,2026年)培养出能模仿所生成回复的注意的软质查询符,而GVote(Tang等,2025年)则从隐藏状态统计中取出合成查询样本. Contractor(Chari and Van Durme,2025年)通过关键杠杆和非原因的注意,对没有排练的条目进行分数,并校正每个上下文的保持比例. 背出"未来"(Gould and van den Hengel, 2026)将后期信使预测好的条目驱逐出,由反因子通过缓存. LLMLingua-2 (Pan et al., 2024)在预填前会压缩文本本身. 阁楼不断排练评分,改变排练的内容和内容。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en:
A KV cache that is compressed before its questions are known must decide, from the context alone, what to remember.
The rehearsal-scoring paradigm decides by rereading: it rehearses everything and remembers nothing, because a cache keeps what it rehearses, and a whole-context rehearsal fills the budget with prose that no query reads.
Two principles turn this failure into a design rule, rehearse what will be read and rehearse as much as there is , and Attic realizes them without training, by letting the model quiz itself on the context.
Alone, Attic is the best training-free method; inside KVgrad and RestoreKV+, it lifts each above every existing method that trains as little; and its lead grows as the budget shrinks.
Since what a cache remembers depends more on what it rehearses than on how it scores, the same principles suggest how to choose the proxy queries of any compressor that stands in for unknown questions, from token eviction to learned compaction.
Holmes’s attic has no elastic walls, and neither does a compressed cache.
The skilful workman does not carry in everything he comes across; he carries in the tools the work will need, and as many as the work needs.
blocks.zh:
一个在已知问题之前被压缩的 KV 缓存,必须单从上下文决定要记住什么.
排练评分范式通过重读来决定:它排练出一切而记忆不到任何东西,因为一个缓存会保留所排练的东西,而一个整段的排练会用没有查询读到的道词来填充预算.
两项原则将这个失败变成设计规则, 排练所要读的和排练的,
单独地,阁楼是最佳的无训练方法;在KVgrad和ReformKV+内部,它将每个方法提升到每一个最多训练的现有方法之上;它的领先随着预算的收缩而增长.
由于缓存所记忆的更多取决于它排练的是什么,而不是它如何计分,同样的原则建议如何选择任何对未知问题的压缩器的代理查询,从象征性的驱逐到学到的收缩.
福尔摩斯的阁楼没有弹性墙壁,压缩缓存也没有.
熟练的工人并不随身携带他遇到的一切;他携带着工作所需要的工具,以及工作所需要的数量。

blocks.en: Appendix C What Coherent Rehearsal Reads
blocks.zh: 附录C 一致的排练读取

blocks.en: A cache keeps what it rehearses; this appendix asks what, within a rehearsal, the model actually reads, and why Attic rehearses its positions as one coherent stream (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 缓存会保留它排练的内容;本附录询问,在排练中,模型实际读到什么,以及阁楼为什么排练它的立场是一条连贯的溪流(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: A rehearsal score is the attention that rehearsed tokens pay back to the context. When the rehearsal is coherent text, as Attic ’s anchor rehearsal and self-generated QA pairs are, the model continues the stream from its own local context and looks back into the document only for tokens it cannot guess: needle values, entities, numbers. These are exactly the tokens that questions about a document ask for, and they are kept. Structure that is predictable but must be read meets the opposite fate: sequentially numbered passage labels (“Paragraph 7”) and the labels of in-context examples are produced from the stream itself, draw no attention back to the document, and are lost.
blocks.zh: 排练分数是排练出符文时对上下文的注意. 当排练是连贯的文字时,正如Attic的锚地排练和自生的QA对一样,模型从自己的本地上下文继续流出并只回想到文档中的符号,它无法猜测:针值,实体,数字. 这些正是关于文件的问题所要求得到的象征,它们被保留。 可预见但必须读取的结构符合相反的命运:按顺序编号的段落标签(“第7段”)和内容内实例的标签从流出,不引起对文档的注意并丢失。

blocks.en: Table 13 (a) shows this on LongBench passage retrieval, whose answer is a “Paragraph N N ” label. Because every sentence of a Wikipedia passage is an askable fact, the content-adaptive amount rehearses about half of the context on this task. As rehearsal grows from isolated anchors (KV 2 , 5%) into coherent text, the kept fraction of label tokens falls from about 5 × 5\times the 5% base rate to the base rate itself, and the score falls with it (Qwen3-8B: 77 → \rightarrow 40; Llama-3.1-8B: 100 → \rightarrow 30).
blocks.zh: 表13(a)在Long Bench通道检索中显示了这一点,其答案是“N.段”标签。 由于维基百科段落的每个句子都是可问的事实,内容-可调取的金额在这项工作上排练了大约一半的上下文. 随着排练从被孤立的主播(KV 2,5%)发展成连贯的文字,所保存的标签符号分数从大约5×5相差于5%的基准率到基准率本身,而得分也随之下降(Quen3-8B:77~\正中40;Llama-3.1-8B:100~\正中30).

blocks.en: To isolate coherence, we keep Attic ’s rehearsed positions fixed and only break the stream: the positions of each chunk are split by a stride into interleaved sparse passes, each rehearsed separately, with the per-token score taken as the maximum over passes. The rehearsed token count is unchanged, but no pass can be continued from local context, so every rehearsed token has to be read back. Table 13 (b) shows both sides of the trade. Labels return: passage retrieval on Qwen3-8B rises from 59 to 78.7, level with KV 2 at its default ratio on the same split (79). Needles leave: RULER drops from 81.8 to 69.8, with multi-key-2 falling from 57 to 5 and multi-value from 98 to 59. Under a tight budget the two kinds of tokens compete for the same slots: coherent rehearsal spends the budget on what the model cannot predict, while sparse rehearsal spreads it over everything rehearsed and crowds the needles out.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离一致性,我们将阁楼的排练位置固定下来,并且只打破溪流:每个块的位置被一行一行分割成相隔的零星通行证,每个通行证分别排练,每盘的分数按最大分数计算。 已排练的道具计数没有变化,但不能从当地上下文继续传出道具,因此每个已排练的道具必须回读. 表13(b)显示贸易双方的情况。 标签回放:Qwen3-8B上的通道检索从59个升至78.7个级别,KV 2在同一分数上默认比例(79个). 无休止:欧盟驻科法治团从81.8降至69.8,多键-2从57降至5,多值从98降至59。 在紧凑的预算下,两种符牌竞相争夺同一个档次:连贯的排练将预算花在模型无法预测的东西上,而零星的排练则将它分散在所排练的一切上并挤出针头.

blocks.en: The finding refines our mechanism from “a cache keeps what it rehearses” to a cache keeps what its rehearsal reads . Questions about a document target facts, entities and numbers, which is what coherent rehearsal reads; it is the reading mode Attic uses. The passage labels of LongBench’s two synthetic tasks (Tables 11 – 12 ) are predictable structure, which coherent rehearsal does not read.
blocks.zh: 调查结论完善了我们的机制,从“缓存保留其排练内容”到缓存保留其排练内容。 文档针对事实、实体和数字的问题,这是连贯的排练读取的内容;它是阁楼的阅读模式。 Long Bench的两个合成任务的段落标签(表11 – 12)是可预测的结构,连贯的排练不读.

blocks.en: Appendix D Selecting ρ \rho for KV 2

blocks.en:
KV 2 rehearses a fixed fraction ρ \rho of anchor tokens per chunk. Its authors set ρ \rho to the keep ratio by default; since this default is far from optimal on our development splits, we give KV 2 a tuned ratio in the main table. For each model we evaluate a grid of ρ \rho on the RULER-4K development split and use the best value on RULER; on LongBench, ρ \rho is selected in the same way on the LongBench development split, and LooGLE, which has no development split, uses the RULER choice; at the 3% keep ratio and in the budget sweep, ρ \rho is re-selected for each keep ratio (Table 14 ). The selected ratios are 0.35 for Qwen3-8B, 0.5 for Llama-3.1-8B and 0.5 for Qwen3-4B at a 5% keep ratio, 0.25 for Qwen3-8B at 3%, and 0.9 at 10%, 20% and 30%; on LongBench, 0.15 for Llama-3.1-8B and 0.5 for Qwen3-8B. For Qwen3-14B, ρ \rho is chosen from { 0.25 , 0.35 , 0.5 } \{0.25,0.35,0.5\} in the same way, and ρ = 0.5 \rho{=}0.5 is selected. Attic uses no such search: its anchor ratio is the keep ratio in every setting.
Table 15 lists the test-split ρ \rho scan plotted in Figure 5 ; it is used only for that analysis and not for selecting ρ \rho .

blocks.en: Appendix F Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 执行情况 细节

blocks.en:
All methods run in kvpress ( NVIDIA, 2024 ) on the same models, prompts and splits. Context is truncated to 32K tokens on LongBench and LooGLE. KVgrad, KVzip+ and RestoreKV+ use their kvpress implementations; KV 2 is implemented in the same scoring and eviction code as KVzip+.
Fixed-block retention in the style of ChunkKV ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , applied to KVzip+ scores, reaches only 22.5 on Qwen3-8B RULER-4K, so we leave it out of the tables.
blocks.zh:
所有方法都以kvpress(NVIDIA,2024)运行于同一种模型上,提示和分出. 上下文在"长本克"(Long Bench)和"LooGLE"(LooGLE)上被切入到32K个令牌. KVgrad,KVzip+和ReprestKV+使用它们的kvpress执行;KV 2在与KVzip+相同的评分和驱逐代码中被执行.
ChunkKV (Liu等,2025b.)风格的固定块保留,被应用到KVZip+分数上,在Quen3-8B RULAR-4K上只达到22.5分,所以我们把它从表格中省出.

blocks.en: On RULER, the development split is a random 10% of each context length (seed 42), and the test split draws the same number of questions from the remainder (seed 7). On LongBench, each task is shuffled (seed 42); the first 25 questions form the development split and the next 75 (Qwen) or 50 (Llama) form the test split.
blocks.zh: 在 RULAR 上,开发分解是每个上下文长度(种子42)的任意10%,测试分解从其余(种子7)中抽取相同的问题. 在"长本克"上,每个任务被洗涤(种子42);前25个问题构成开发分裂,后75个(Quen)或50个(Llama)构成测试分裂.

blocks.en: Every rehearsal-based method shares the KVzip+ scoring and eviction of Eq. ( 2 ), combining the scores of several rehearsed texts by an element-wise maximum. Anchors and the content-adaptive amount follow Section 4.3 , with chunks of 4096 tokens rehearsed and scored separately.
blocks.zh: 基于排练的每一种方法都共享了 Eq. (2) 的 KVzip+ 分数和驱逐分数, 将数个排练的文本的分数以元素为最大。 锁定器和内容调整量与4.3节相接,排练出4096个令牌并分别打出分数。

blocks.en: The QA pairs are decoded greedily from the prompt below, appended to the context after two newlines and the same for all models and benchmarks: Write 6 questions a reader is likely to ask about the text above. After each question, answer it by quoting the exact words from the text that contain the answer. Format each as: Q: ... A: ... The header H is “Questions a reader may ask about the previous context, with answers quoted from it:”.
blocks.zh: QA对从下面的快取被贪婪地解码出,在两条新线后附在上下文后,所有模型和基准都相同: 给读者写6个问题, 在每一个问题之后,通过引用包含答案的文本中的确切词句来回答. 格式各为:Q:.A:.标题H是“读者可能就前一个上下文提出问题,并从中引用答案:”。

blocks.en: RestoreKV+ + Attic adds the restore tokens and LoRA adapter that the RestoreKV authors released for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B, unchanged, to Attic ’s selection. They were trained on KVzip+ selections; retraining them on ours for 1000 steps does not help (83.6 vs. 84.3, Qwen3-8B RULER-4K development split).
blocks.zh: ReturnKV++ Attic 添加了 ReturnKV 作者为 Qune3-8B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 发布的恢复令牌和 LORA 适配器,没有改变,为 Attic 的选择. 他们接受了关于KVzip+选拔的培训;他们接受我们1000个步骤的再培训没有帮助(83.6 vs 84.3, Qune3-8 B RULR-4K发展分裂)。
